Sends HTTP Basic authentication header

```swift title="Swift"
import Crawlberg

let engineConfig = try crawlConfigFromJson("{\"auth\":{\"password\":\"testpass\",\"type\":\"basic\",\"username\":\"testuser\"},\"respect_robots_txt\":false}")
let engineObj = try createEngine(config: engineConfig)
let url = "https://example.com"
let result = try await Crawlberg.scrape(engine: engineObj, url: url)
debugPrint(result.authHeaderSent())
debugPrint(result.statusCode())
```
